note: In his commentary on Isaiah 2:22, Jerome defends his translation by correcting a Jewish anti- christian reading. He also tells the reader how to interpret this verse as a messianic reference. The relevant passage of Jerome’s commentary can be found, in Latin and English, in Matthew A. Kraus: The Vulgate and Jerome’s Biblical Exegesis. _Vulgata in Dialogue. Special issue IOVS 2022:_ 99–119, at p. 105 (online journal).
